Oman school holidays 2026–2027

Shows the days and hours until the next break, the school days left, and every holiday this year with return dates.

Prepared and reviewed by the Mustahaqati team · Last updated: 2026-11-03

How many days to the holiday?

Oman school calendar 2026–2027

EventDatesLengthReturn
Semester 1Sun, 6 Sept 2026 – Wed, 30 Dec 2026——
National Day holidayWed, 25 Nov 2026 – Thu, 26 Nov 20262 days—
Break between terms (estimated)Fri, 22 Jan 2027 – Sat, 30 Jan 20279 daysBack Sun, 31 Jan 2027
Semester 2Sun, 31 Jan 2027 – Tue, 13 Jul 2027——

Students started a week later, on 6 September, to support the Khareef season, and the calendar ends on 13 July 2027. It lists no holidays, so the countdown adds the expected official holidays, and the break between terms is inferred from the exam and term dates.

Frequently asked questions

When does the second term start in Oman in 2027?

On Sunday 31 January 2027 for staff and students, after first-term exams end on 21 January.

Sources

  • Atheer — annual school calendar, Ministerial Decision 190/2026 (15 Jul 2026, Arabic)
  • Oman Observer — new school year begins on Sunday (5 Sep 2026)
